import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import type { RadioGroupOption } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { FormElement } from '../catalog-support.js';
export declare class RadioGroup extends FormElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        options: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        value: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        appearance: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    options: readonly RadioGroupOption[];
    value: string | null | undefined;
    defaultValue: string | null | undefined;
    size: string;
    appearance: string;
    private state;
    constructor();
    get committedValue(): string | null;
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(value: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    updated(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private choose;
    private key;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
